qa_scope: 逐张实际画面核对动作、器械连续连接、握持、比例、完整部位和组内机位；不依据静态生成图确认肌肉发力、实际重量、带张力、锚点承载或临床效果。

images.prompt:
Use case: scientific-educational.
Asset type: one standalone rehabilitation demonstration photograph, action 174 T-AXU-033 step s01.
Input images: all three supplied images are appearance references only, defining this SAME adult East Asian woman, facial identity, age, skin tone, build, black ponytail, fitted plain white short-sleeve shirt, full-length charcoal gray trousers, gray-blue background and soft studio photography. Do not copy their arm poses.
Primary request: show this woman standing stably preparing a TWO-DUMBBELL SUPINATED BICEPS CURL. Both upper arms rest close beside her torso, shoulders relaxed. Both elbows are nearly extended with a slight comfortable bend, not locked. Each hand securely holds one identical small light black hex dumbbell down beside the front/side of her thigh. Both forearms are SUPINATED with palms facing FORWARD relative to her chest, not palms inward; dumbbell shafts run left-right across the palms. Wrists straight naturally aligned with forearms, realistic wrapped fingers and thumbs. Two dumbbells remain clearly distinct.
Composition: full body portrait 4:5 from a near side view with 25-degree anterior oblique angle, she faces picture right. Both hands, dumbbells, shoulder-elbow-wrist chains and both feet must remain separately visible. Natural neutral upright spine, neck and gaze forward, no torso lean, feet hip-width on same flat non-slip gray studio floor, gray plain athletic trainers. Entire head, fingers, both complete dumbbells, both shoes and soft contact shadow inside frame with generous margins. Normal lens, realistic body proportions, soft diffuse light, seamless gray-blue floor/background matching references.
Text: none. Exactly one woman, two hands, two identical small dumbbells, one clear posture. No arrows, words, numbers, logos, watermarks, collage, extra equipment, bent wrists, hammer grip, shoulder elevation or body swing.
images.qa_status: 逐张实际画面检查通过，供教学图审核

visual_inspection.method: 查看内置imagegen实际返回画面，并调用view_image核对落盘图；只调整显示data URL MIME标识，未编辑图片像素。
visual_inspection.posture: 双臂在身侧，双上臂近身，双肘接近伸直但自然；双手旋后掌心朝前，各握一只轻小黑六角哑铃。
checks: 旋后握法可辨，未变成掌心向内锤式。
双哑铃形状相同，各自由对应手指闭合握持，手腕自然。
躯干直立、双足稳定，肩未耸起。
同一女性外观、黑马尾、白短袖、深灰裤与柔光灰蓝背景；写实摄影。
头部、双手、双脚及全部器械完整入镜；人体比例与连接自然。
一张仅一个姿势，无文字、编号、箭头、拼图、水印。
limitations: 肘角由教学外观判断，不作为精确角度测量。

images.prompt:

Input images: the three supplied photographs specify the SAME adult East Asian woman's face, age, skin, body, black ponytail, plain white short-sleeved T-shirt, charcoal full-length trousers and gray-blue studio photographic style; these are identity and style references only.
Primary request: starting posture for standing TWO-HAND HIGH-ANCHOR RESISTANCE-BAND TRICEPS PRESS-DOWN. She stands upright facing picture right, feet hip-width on a flat non-slip floor, soft knees, neutral pelvis/spine and neck, no lean. Both upper arms hang close along her torso; both elbows bent about 90 degrees at waist level, both forearms extend almost horizontally forward toward picture right. Both hands separately and securely grasp matching compact black D-handles in front of her lower chest/upper abdomen, neutral wrists, palms face downward through the handle grips. TWO identical blue elastic resistance tubes securely clip to that high plate at two closely spaced attachment loops; each tube runs in a clear straight diagonal line down-left to ONE corresponding hand-held black handle. Both anchor-to-tube-to-handle continuities and attachments visible, mild tautness, realistic gripping and no tubes wrapping around body. Wall plate held by visible fasteners. Keep equipment minimal; no pulley, machine, dumbbells, extra loops or unexplained floating ends.
Composition: full body portrait 4:5, nearly side-on with a 25-degree anterior oblique angle so BOTH arms/handles/tubes can be inspected without overlap. Her same gray plain trainers, entire head, both shoes, both full hands, both full handles and complete high anchor with generous margin in one frame; anchor high at picture right, woman slightly left of center, sufficient headroom. Seamless gray-blue studio floor/backdrop with subtle wall-floor transition, soft diffuse realistic light and contact shadows, normal lens, natural proportions, calm expression.
Exactly one woman, one posture, two hands and two tube-and-handle routes. No words, numbers, arrows, logos, watermark, collage; no overhead elbow pose, shoulder elevation, forward torso lean or locked joints.
